name: eu.moneymagician/mcp
title: Money Magician
description: Money Magician: AI accounting. Connect agents to your invoices, expenses, bank data, taxes & profit.

tools.name: query_invoices
tools.description: Search and filter invoices by various criteria. Returns a response with top-level "primary_currency" and "currency_warning" fields. Each invoice includes explicit "currency", "comparable" (true if matches primary currency), and "converted_to_primary" fields alongside separate numeric "amount_gross", "amount_net", and "tax_amount" values. Also has TWO status fields: "processing_status" (pending/processing/completed/paid) and "payment_status" (paid/unpaid). Amounts in different currencies are NOT directly comparable or summable. Also includes tags/categories for each invoice in the response. converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, source } when a bank reconciliation has recorded the actual settlement amount in the user's primary currency. Requires the Start or Business plan.

status.description: Filter by processing_status (OCR workflow stage). Note: completed means OCR is done but NOT necessarily paid; the payment_status field in results reflects the actual payment state.

tag.description: Filter by a single tag name (partial match)

tools.name: get_invoice_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific invoice including all extracted data, payments, and tags. Returns top-level "currency", "comparable" (true if matches primary currency), "converted_to_primary", and "currency_warning" fields. Has TWO status fields: "processing_status" (OCR workflow stage) and "payment_status" (paid/unpaid). Amounts include both total_gross and total_net values in the amounts object. converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, source } when a bank reconciliation has recorded the actual settlement amount. Requires the Start or Business plan.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Search for customers by name, company name, or email Requires the Start or Business plan.

search.description: Search term for customer name, company name, or email

tools.name: get_financial_summary
tools.description: Get a comprehensive financial summary including total invoices, amounts by currency (both gross and net), and top vendors with both gross and net spending totals

tools.name: calculate_taxes
tools.description: Calculate tax information for invoices within a date range, providing breakdown by tax rate. Both date_from and date_to are required. Requires the Start or Business plan.

tax_regime.description: Tax regime to apply (default: 'simple'). Falls back to the user's default tax regime when omitted.

tools.name: list_created_invoices
tools.description: List invoices that you have created and sent to customers, with optional filtering. Returns both gross (incl. tax) and net (excl. tax) amounts for each invoice. Requires the Start or Business plan.

tools.name: get_expenses_by_category
tools.description: Get total expenses grouped by category/tag for creating pie charts and expense analysis. Returns pre-aggregated data with both gross and net totals per category, invoice counts, and colors. Much faster than fetching individual invoices when you need category summaries.

tools.name: get_profitability_metrics
tools.description: Get profitability analysis including Gross Profit (Net Revenue - COGS), Gross Margin, Net Result (Total Income - Total Expenses), expense breakdown by COGS vs OpEx, and quarterly COGS/OpEx breakdown. Includes bank and Wise transactions with COGS categories. Note: Gross Profit (Net Revenue - COGS) is distinct from Net Result (Total Income - Total Expenses). COGS = Cost of Goods Sold (Inventory, Production Labor, Direct Contractors, Shipping). OpEx = Operating Expenses (everything else). For calendar-year periods, date_from is YYYY-01-01 and date_to is YYYY-12-31. Returns quarterly_breakdown array with COGS/OpEx per quarter.

date_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). For calendar year queries use YYYY-01-01

date_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). For calendar year queries use YYYY-12-31

tools.name: get_tax_position
tools.description: Get comprehensive tax position metrics including cash-basis tax (collected vs paid), VAT timing impact (float advantage vs cash tied up), and true tax position. Matches the Tax Position section on Dashboard. Useful for VAT/GST reporting, cash flow optimization, and understanding tax obligations. Requires the Start or Business plan.

tools.name: get_reconciliation_status
tools.description: Get reconciliation/matching status for invoices and transactions. Shows how many expense invoices, sales invoices, bank transactions, and Wise transactions are matched, unmatched, partial, or ignored. Useful for year-end cleanup and understanding what remains to be reconciled. Requires the Start or Business plan.

tools.name: get_top_customers
tools.description: Get top customers by sales revenue with both gross and net amounts. Shows which customers generated the most revenue in a period. Requires the Start or Business plan.

limit.description: Number of top customers to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_top_vendors
tools.description: Get top vendors by expense spending. Returns a UNIFIED vendor list where every entry has an explicit "currency" field, a "comparable" flag (true = primary currency, false = foreign), and "converted_to_primary" field. converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, invoices_converted, invoices_total, source } when bank reconciliation has recorded actual settlement amounts. Includes a top-level "currency_warning". Amounts in different currencies are NOT comparable or summable. For calendar-year periods, date_from is YYYY-01-01 and date_to is YYYY-12-31. Requires the Start or Business plan.

date_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). For year queries use YYYY-01-01

date_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). For year queries use YYYY-12-31

limit.description: Number of top vendors to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_vendor_summary
tools.description: Get a detailed financial summary for a specific vendor. Returns authoritative net/gross/tax totals in the user's primary currency with "comparable: true", individual invoice list (each with explicit "currency", "comparable", and "converted_to_primary" fields), and foreign currency totals marked with "comparable: false". converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, source } when bank reconciliation has recorded actual settlement amounts. Includes a top-level "currency_warning". Totals are authoritative and more reliable than manually summing query_invoices results. Requires the Start or Business plan.

vendor.description: Vendor name to look up (case-insensitive partial match)
